hookups.source: ReserveAmerica site list, loop 'Family Campground Loop C' (20 'Campsite Electric' sites 'Electric Hookup available: 50 amp', one 30 amp, one 20 amp; all 'Full Hookup - no' with no water hookup listed, where other NC parks' sites list 'Water Hookup'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Booking site: Loop A 36 and Loop B 32 non-electric sites; Loop C 22 electric and 7 non-electric sites plus 8 camper cabins. Nearly all back-ins, listed driveways mostly 20-40 ft, the longest 46-55 ft (sites 012, 023, 025, 057, 077); one 48-ft pull-through (078).

sites.source: ReserveAmerica site list for loops 'Family Campground Loop A/B/C' (site type and driveway column), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Booking page: campsites 'can be made for today and can be made up to 6 Month(s) in advance.' Holiday weekends (Memorial Day, July 4th, Labor Day) need 2 nights, cut to 1 night when booking within 14 days of arrival (cabins keep 2). The front gate is locked at posted closing times, with no entry or exit after.

booking.source: https://northcarolinastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/morrow-mountain-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NC&parkId=552856 (Booking Window; 'Business rules for Holiday Weekends'; alert), read 2026-10-22

note: Family campground in three loops near Lake Tillery; Loop C holds the electric sites and the camper cabins. --Claude
summary: Changed site count 106 -> 97 (booking site: 75 non-electric, 22 electric in Loop C). Confirmed showers, year-round, ReserveAmerica booking; added 50-amp electric (no water at the site), max listed driveway 55 ft, one pull-through, drinking water, 6-month window with same-day booking, holiday 2-night minimum waived within 14 days, nightly gate lock. Fees ($30 non-electric / $35 electric incl. $3/night reservation fee; RA $27/$32 current) stand. ncparks.gov's camping page carries no campground details. Not stated: dump station (kept from earlier), sewer, walk-ups, max stay.
